title: lithospermum petraeum
intro: Lithospermum petraeum, commonly known as Rocky Stonecrop, is a flowering plant that belongs to the borage family (Boraginaceae). The health benefits of Lithospermum petraeum include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic, making it useful in traditional medicine for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Lithospermum petraeum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
